projecthero.omnitrix.big_chill.freezing_: A cone of freezing breath (8 blocks): 12 and chilled -- anything already chilled freezes solid for 2 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.big_chill.ice_shard: A shard of ice (20 blocks): 7 and chilled.
projecthero.omnitrix.big_chill.frost_gri: Seize the creature in reach (4.5 blocks): 13, frozen solid in ice for 3 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.big_chill.frost_nov: A burst of cold round you (5 blocks): 14, chilled and pushed back.
projecthero.omnitrix.big_chill.moth_flig: Take off or land on your moth wings (double-tap jump works too).
projecthero.omnitrix.big_chill.phase.des: Turn intangible for 5 s: through walls, and nothing physical can touch you. Press again to end it early.
Rise, then plunge: the landing freezes everything near (4 blocks), 17 and chilled.
projecthero.omnitrix.big_chill.frost_flo: The water round you (6 blocks) freezes over into ice that thaws by itself.
projecthero.omnitrix.big_chill.cloak.des: Wrap your wings round you: invisible for 10 s and hunters lose track of you. Attacking opens the cloak.
projecthero.omnitrix.big_chill.frost_arm: A skin of ice for 6 s: 40% less damage, and anyone who hits you up close is chilled.
A 4 s snowstorm wheels round you (6 blocks): 2 twice a second (16 in all) and chilled.
projecthero.omnitrix.big_chill.absolute_: ULTIMATE: 1 s drawing the cold in, then everything within 8 blocks takes 45 and is frozen solid for 4 s.
projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.big_chi: Big Chill, the Necrofriggian: a moth-like ghost of the ice who breathes freezing cold, flies on moth wings and turns intangible to slip through walls.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.big_chill.role: Controller: freezing breath, ice and intangibility.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.big_chill.pass: Moth wings: flight on X (or a double-tap of jump).
Cold-blooded: immune to freezing and powder snow.
Chill: his ice slows creatures and frosts them over; a chilled creature hit by another freezing move freezes solid (encased in ice, rooted).
projecthero.omnitrix.info.big_chill.weak: Fire: fire and lava do 50% more damage to him.
Phasing only stops physical harm: fire, magic and the like still reach him.
